description: Guard for the Glowming campaign files, for Anton, Etienne and Louis, never for Riaan (operator ruling 2026-10-03; design note docs/glowming-campaign-guard-identity.md): guard.js decides who is working and, unless it is Riaan, checks every write, shell command and connector call against an allow-list using the files on disk; post.js checks what a shell command did (also when it failed), puts back what the rules forbid (keeping the displaced version), and warns, never blocks, when a file tool wrote a key, password, card or ID number or a banned claim (Riaan, 2026-10-02: warn, never refuse).
